# system.killEvents

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Kill key events (i.e. after a LONG PRESS event, a KEY RELEASE event may be skipped)

```lua
system.killEvents(event)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `event` | number | yes |  |

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua
local function event(widget, category, value, x, y)
  if category == EVT_KEY and value == KEY_ENTER_LONG then
    openMenu(widget)
    system.killEvents(KEY_ENTER_BREAK)   -- the release would otherwise also count as a short press
    return true
  end
  return false
end
```

Real projects also kill touch sequences after acting on a touch (`system.killEvents(TOUCH_START)`) so the rest of the gesture doesn't reach other UI.
